title: nf-zeta-general
objective: Implement signature metadata and a general arbitrary-complex Dedekind-zeta reference evaluator with honest error diagnostics.

handoff.summary: Added exact QQbar signature/embedding metadata, the frozen general-zeta coefficient-provider and resource contracts, and a readable arbitrary-precision inverse-Mellin/Meijer-G evaluator for xi_K, Lambda_K, raw zeta values, residues, low derivatives, functional-equation reflection, and batches. The module docstring is the derivation memo. Independent prefix/range/mesh refinements and every proof-status diagnostic are explicit; unstable scalar requests fail instead of returning plausible values. Focused CPython tests cover QQ, an exact signature certificate, a nonabelian mixed-signature cubic against Sage/PARI values and derivatives, functional equation, batching, preflight-before-provider, and rejection of an underresolved totally complex quartic.
risks: This is deliberately a mpmath reference, not the production Acb kernel; Meijer-G evaluation is too slow for plots and large batches.
Coefficient and quadrature tails are refinement-tested but not proved, so every result remains a numerical approximation with rigorous=false.
Raw derivatives at exact nonpositive gamma singularities still require a reciprocal-gamma jet; values and trivial-zero orders are supported.
The batch route shares coefficient generation but not Meijer-G kernel preparation.
next_steps: Integration should add thin NumberField.signature()/embedding metadata and DedekindZetaFunction routing hooks outside this lane's claims.
Adapt Project 3's zeta_coefficients(bound, degree=..., splitting_provider=...) function behind an object exposing coefficients(bound), preserving [a_1,...,a_B] indexing.
Use the native audit's packed Acb design for a production kernel while preserving separate arithmetic-radius and analytic-remainder diagnostics.
Run declared broad strict/native and four-platform gates only after integration; root explicitly deferred broad builds during this lane.
